mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, product_id, rating, comment FROM t_comment WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT c.product_id FROM t_comment c JOIN t_user u ON u.id = c.user_id JOIN t_product p ON p.id = c.product_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.auth_epoch = #{authEpoch} AND c.product_id IN #{id} AND c.id = (SELECT MAX(newer.id) FROM t_comment newer WHERE newer.user_id = c.user_id AND newer.product_id = c.product_id) AND c.rating BETWEEN 4 AND 5
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM t_comment WHERE product_id = #{productId}
SELECT id, user_id, product_id, rating, comment FROM t_comment ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, user_id, product_id, rating, comment FROM t_comment ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_comment (user_id, product_id, rating, comment) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{rating}, #{comment})
